justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ClassLoaderObjectInputStream.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ClassLoaderObjectInputStreamTest.java. The class has very low fan-out: one field, one constructor, and two overridden methods, using only JDK types (ObjectInputStream, ObjectStreamClass, InputStream, IOException, StreamCorruptedException, Proxy, ClassLoader). Fan-in is also low: rg found no src/main production references, and only the test class uses it (7 instantiations); the remaining mentions are docs/release notes, not code dependencies. This is not hub-like modularization.
